rule: STRONG. Endings stack: every data row whose flag equals its value is shown in file order (no break). Death card: a gated, weighted pick (row enabled while flag < value, zone and level gates, inclusive roll 0..total, walk enabled rows); fix the index so the chosen row is the row itself. Standing: seven bands from a standing value, shown only for discovered zones. Quest list: grouped by place, shown at display threshold, struck through at completion. Subtitles: time per line = clip duration x line characters / total characters, fallback 0.08 s per character.
keep: Stacked rows in data order, no break
Gated weighted pick with an inclusive roll
Voice-timed lines on a solid strip, bottom anchored

Note pages with an end sentinel
